name: Border
summary: A frame of one semantic colour around a block of content. It says what state the content is in without adding a word to it.
summaryZh: 给一块内容加一圈语义色的边框。它说明这块内容处在什么状态,不用往里加一个字。

variants.name: Primary
variants.note: The brand colour, drawn in the graphic form so the frame reads as a shape.

sizes.name: Medium
sizes.note: The default padding needs no modifier class.

states.name: Focus within
states.note: A control inside the frame has the keyboard. The frame takes the focus ring, so the reader can see which box they are in.

parts.name: Body
parts.note: The content inside the frame. It paints no surface of its own — the frame owns the one surface there is.

slots.name: default
slots.description: The content the frame is drawn around. It goes in `.um-border__body`.
slots.descriptionZh: 被边框围起来的内容,放在 `.um-border__body` 里。

a11y.notes: The frame is a div and adds nothing to the accessibility tree: a border is a shape, and the content inside it is read as it is. When the frame holds a control, the frame takes the focus ring through :focus-within, so a keyboard reader can see where they are. Give the frame a role and an accessible name only when the group of controls inside it needs one.
a11y.notesZh: 边框是个 div,不给无障碍树增加任何东西:边框是个形状,里面的内容照常读。当边框里装着控件时,边框用 :focus-within 接住焦点环,键盘用户才看得见自己在哪儿。只有当里面这组控件需要名字时,才给边框加 role 和可访问名称。

examples.title: The five states
examples.description: Each frame carries the colour of the state it announces. The colour is the graphic form of the tone, because the frame is a shape whose colour says it all — the raw fill colour clears nothing as a picture.
examples.descriptionZh: 每个边框带着它要宣布的那个状态的颜色。这里用的是状态的图形色,因为边框是个全靠颜色说话的颜色 —— 填充色本身作为图形什么都保证不了。
examples.markup:
The build is running on node A.
The build passed.
The certificate expires in three days.
The disk is full.
The report covers the last 24 hours.

examples.title: Sizes
examples.description: The size is the padding inside the frame. The medium size is the default and needs no modifier class.
examples.descriptionZh: 尺寸说的是边框里的留白。中号是默认尺寸,不需要修饰类。
examples.markup:
Small
Medium
Large

examples.title: Without a state
examples.description: The base class on its own is a plain frame. It is the one to reach for when the content should be set off without announcing anything about it.
examples.descriptionZh: 只写基类就是一个素边框。内容只是需要被框起来、又不需要借此宣布什么的时候,用这个。
examples.markup: A plain frame, in the mood's own border colour.

notes: The frame paints the surface and the body inside it paints nothing. Two translucent layers would be a colour no role names, and a guarantee made against one of them is a guarantee about a surface nobody sees. The frame's own colour is the graphic form of the tone, because the frame is a shape that carries the state on its own: the raw fill colour clears 4.5:1 as a background for text and clears nothing as a picture.
notesZh: 边框负责画那层底色,里面的内容什么都不画。两层半透明叠起来是一个谁都没命名的颜色,而对着其中一层做的保证,保证的是一层没人看得见的表面。边框的颜色用的是状态的图形色,因为边框本身就是一个全靠颜色承载状态的形状:填充色作为文字底色能到 4.5:1,作为图形则什么都保证不了。
